title: Large Language Models Naively Recover Ethnicity from Individual Records
abstract: arXiv:2601.21132v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: I demonstrate that large language models can infer ethnicity from names with accuracy exceeding that of Bayesian Improved Surname Geocoding (BISG) without additional training data, enabling inference outside the United States and to contextually appropriate classification categories. Using stratified samples from Florida and North Carolina voter files with self-reported race, LLM-based classification achieves up to 84.7% accuracy, outperforming BISG (68.2%) on balanced samples. I test six models including Gemini 3 Flash, GPT-4o, and open-source alternatives such as DeepSeek v3.2 and GLM-4.7. Enabling extended reasoning can improve accuracy by 1-3 percentage points, though effects vary across contexts; including metadata such as party registration reaches 86.7%. LLM classification also reduces the income bias inherent in BISG, where minorities in wealthier neighborhoods are systematically misclassified as White. I further validate usi

translated_title: 大语言模型能够从个人记录中直接推断族裔信息
translated_abstract: 我证明了大语言模型无需额外训练数据即可从姓名中推断族裔，其准确率超过贝叶斯改进姓氏地理编码法（BISG），并且能够将推断扩展到美国以外地区以及符合具体情境的分类类别。使用佛罗里达州和北卡罗来纳州选民档案中带有自我报告种族信息的分层样本，基于大语言模型的分类准确率高达84.7%，在平衡样本上优于BISG的68.2%。我测试了六个模型，包括Gemini 3 Flash、GPT-4o以及开源替代方案如DeepSeek v3.2和GLM-4.7。启用扩展推理可将准确率提高1至3个百分点，但效果因情境而异；加入政党注册等元数据可使准确率达到86.7%。大语言模型分类还减少了BISG固有的收入偏差——在BISG方法中，居住在较富裕社区的少数族裔会被系统性地误分类为白人。我还进一步验证了（原文截断）
tldr: 大语言模型无需额外训练数据即可从姓名中推断族裔，准确率超越传统BISG方法，还能减少收入偏差，并将族裔推断能力扩展到美国以外的地区。
en_tdlr: Large language models can infer ethnicity from names without additional training data, outperforming BISG in accuracy, reducing its inherent income bias, and extending inference beyond the United States.
